title: Review on Criminalisation of Attempted Suicide and Marital Immunity for Rape
what_it_is: Review on Criminalisation of Attempted Suicide and Marital Immunity for Rape

sections.label: Penal Code review marital immunity
sections.summary: A Committee set up in July 2016 is reviewing marital immunity for rape and other Penal Code areas, aiming to finish later this year before public feedback.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kok Heng Leun
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) what is the outcome of the Government's review on the issue of marital immunity for rape; and (b) whether any legislative change will be introduced and, if so, when.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: We set up this Committee in July 2016 to review the Penal Code.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Some of the areas that are being looked at by the Committee include attempted suicide, marital immunity for rape, punishments for sex offenders and the need to create new criminal offences to deal with the changing crime environment.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: In addition to these, the Committee is also undertaking a fairly fundamental review on the principles which underlie our penal laws, including elements of criminal liability, the required mental element, intention, knowledge, the scope of mental health defences, as well as some of the language used in the Penal Code.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: The Committee aims to complete its work later this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: We will then invite feedback from the public on the recommendations.

sections.label: Time for feedback
sections.summary: Enough time will be given for feedback, but everyone has to work quite hard on it.
